description: This file defines the ImageFormatter class for Drupal, implementing a plugin that formats image fields with configurable styles, links, and loading attributes.

classes.name: ImageFormatter
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for formatting image fields with configurable styles, links, and loading options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the formatter with dependencies like current user, image style storage, and file URL generator.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the formatter with services from the container.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings for the formatter.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the formatter, allowing selection of image style, link type, and loading attribute.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary of current formatter settings for display.

methods.name: viewElements
methods.description: Generates renderable image elements based on field items, applying styles, links, and loading attributes.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates configuration dependencies, especially related to image styles.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies, replacing image styles if needed.
